issue.title: test_stitches_action_override_wins_over_legacy_commits_alias fails: 'minus' key now collides with the collapse_panel_folds default
issue.description: tests/test_keymaps_registry_loading.py::test_stitches_action_override_wins_over_legacy_commits_alias fails on current master (verified via git stash on a clean tree — identical failure, so this predates and is unrelated to my in-progress work). Reproduction: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_keymaps_registry_loading.py::test_stitches_action_override_wins_over_legacy_commits_alias -q'. It asserts reg.app.stitches_next == 'minus' after configuring stitches_next: minus in the keymap override, but gets 'j' instead. registry.py logs: "Duplicate key 'minus': action 'stitches_next' conflicts with ['collapse_panel_folds']; reverting to default 'j'". Root cause: commit 62a4ddeb5 'feat(ace): add `-` panel fold sweep with per-panel reverse' bound the minus key to a new default keymap action collapse_panel_folds, which the test's chosen override key (minus, for stitches_next) now collides with -- the test predates that default binding. Likely fix: either change the test's override key to one not claimed by any default action, or reconsider binding collapse_panel_folds to minus by default. Discovered while running just check for an unrelated CLI-rename plan (sase/repos/plans/202608/stitch_create_migration.md) in workspace sase_13; confirmed pre-existing and not caused by that change.
